name: HairDeck
summary: Research model (Tsinghua, CMU, CUHK) that turns one character image into stylized 3D hair cards with spring-bone chains already attached, so the hair animates. Each card keeps its own UVs; export as GLB or attach to an avatar and export VRM. Geometry and UVs only, no textures yet.

publisher.name: Yuze He et al. (Tsinghua / CMU / CUHK)

access.notes: Code and checkpoints Apache-2.0. Depends on gated SAM 3 and DINOv3 (accept their licences on Hugging Face). Local run needs Linux + CUDA; free online demo on HF Spaces.

procedure: For local use, clone https://github.com/hyz317/HairDeck on Linux with a CUDA GPU
Accept the SAM 3 and DINOv3 licences on Hugging Face
Run inference on a character image and export GLB or VRM

verdict.why: Rare open model for animation-ready hair cards with bones, Apache-2.0 code and weights, not gated itself, demo online. Minus: no textures yet, gated dependencies, Linux/CUDA only.

image.alt: Grid of stylized 3D haircuts on mannequin heads generated by HairDeck from anime character images
